review.notes: Full review at ffb4475. Gate re-run: every check OK; depcheck: 235 roadmaps, 2261 edges, 0 problems; no change outside the folder; order against #1187 stated in the description. Suggested.lean elaborates with only 22 sorry warnings; the one-tactic padding probe fails on all 22 theorems; #check signatures and Riemannian instances match the README. Seeded sample (§§1.1-2.3) verified against andrews-dg-ch16, nicolaescu-lectures, spacetime-guided-tour, bishop-rg and brewin-rnc (O'Neill and Milnor are uncertified). Headline locators verified in eschenburg, kwong, zhu, nicolaescu, bishop, spacetime-guided-tour, caponio-javaloyes, petersen-wink, taimanov and lyons. 192 dotted names resolve at the pins; 24 supplier roadmaps and 7 anchors resolve on main. Blocking: R01 (P2), the Morse index theorem is statable at the pins (a scratch statement with two short definitions and Tau Ceti's conjugateMultiplicity elaborates) but is declared not statable. P3: five headline theorems have no locator; Tau Ceti's Weyl-dimension declarations are cited as roadmap files; TauCeti.Orientable and curveVelocityWithin are missing from the contract, R3.1's Needs line is incomplete and a Tau Ceti link is not at the pin; R3.4, R4.7 and R7.4 definitions and sign conventions lack Checks; one §1.2 Check is worded backwards. Six source issues recorded.
